evidence: Source inspection of BodySample, WingSample, ModelRootSample, LayerColorSample and history readers; no classes or game executed
unchangedSamples: exact owned copies of identical admitted endpoint samples, avoiding quaternion decomposition/reconstruction
unchangedMatrices: WingSample.blend clones equal validated matrices, including when other matrices in the same sample change
unchangedRoots: ModelRootSample reuses an equal immutable root and clones an equal basis even when world position changes; separate double position components retain exact equal endpoint bits
unchangedColors: equal body/layer RGBA channels retain exact float bits; changed channels retain the existing interpolation formula
existingAttachmentBehavior: AttachmentTransform already preserves equal endpoint matrices; no change to that interpolation
changingRootBasis: Previous positive-handed orthogonal arithmetic is retained; previously unsupported changing affine roots use AttachmentTransform bounded polar interpolation for same-parity reflection and shear
changingRootLimits: Parity changes, singular or ill-conditioned factors, failed convergence and non-positive stretch remain unsupported; this interpolation is not proof of the native engine's intermediate poses
rootCoordinateContract: Capture and recorded-root playback require cameraRelative=true; the built-in native frame producer already declares this space
